question: What minimum support price per quintal of groundnut has been declared by the Government of India for the marketing season 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 5275**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rs. 5275 minimum support price per quintal of groundnut was declared by the Government of India for the marketing season 2020-21**__.

 __
 
• **The total increase in overall minimum support price was Rs. 274 per quintal.**
 
• During 2017-18, the minimum support price was Rs. 4450 per quintal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The government has increased the MSP of Kharif crops for the marketing season 2020-21, to ensure a remunerative price to the growers for their produce.
 
 
• The highest increase in MSP was proposed for Nigerseed (Rs 755 per quintal) followed by Sesame (Rs 370 per quintal).
 
• Minimum Support Price (MSP) is a form of market intervention by the Government of India to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in agricultural prices.
 
• The Minimum Support Price is announced by the Government of India at the beginning of the sowing season for certain crops based on the recommendations of the **Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)**.​
